title: Unveiling Cultural Blind Spots: Analyzing the Limitations of mLLMs in Procedural Text Comprehension
reasoning: The CAPTex benchmark introduced in the paper explicitly includes 'Religious and Spiritual Practices' as one of its ten evaluation domains (Domain 7). The paper evaluates mLLMs on their ability to understand and reason about cultural procedures related to rituals, such as Islamic funeral practices versus traditional Toraja ceremonies.
